content:
incident-bot: Pager: High 5xx rate detected for region-affinity route group 'eu->apac-affinity' — alerting oncall.
oncall-jack: I'm on it. seeing a spike in 502/504 from eu-west egress to apac pools. Any recent deploys?
eng-leo: No deploys to routing code in last 24h. We did promote a routing policy change ~23:40 UTC (new affinity weights) — could be related.
infra-amit: I'm pulling active policy versions now. dig and metrics show increased retried connections and TCP resets to apac edge.
sre-aya: Customer impact: overall platform error rate up ~3.8% for EU origin traffic, latency also up ~250ms for fallback paths.
pm-maria: Noted a SaaS customer (AcmeAnalytics) experiencing request timeouts — they just opened a support ticket. cs-lina can you triage with them?
cs-lina: On it, pinged the customer and asked for request IDs. They're seeing timeouts for analytics ingestion.
oncall-jack: Can someone dump the routing policy that was promoted? need to see weights + pin rules.
eng-leo: Pasting snippet of the promoted policy (sanitized):

```yaml
policy_id: p-2026-07-affinity
rules:
  - match: origin.region == "eu"
    action: route
    targets:
      - region: eu-west
        weight: 90
      - region: apac-sg
        weight: 10
    affinity: session_cookie
    ttl_secs: 30
```

eng-leo: The issue is a new "affinity: session_cookie" semantics — it sets a secondary shadow routing for certain missing cookies which defaults to apac-sg in our implementation.
infra-amit: Confirming: some edge proxies were returning 302 to /session-setup with Set-Cookie, but if clients ignore that, they get flagged into a fallback path that resolves to apac-sg via the policy engine.
sre-aya: That matches: traces show ~12% of EU requests lacking the cookie get an early rewrite which routes to apac, then retried back to EU resulting in 5xx.
oncall-jack: Ok mitigation options: 1) rollback policy to previous version, 2) tweak policy to set fallback to eu-west, 3) push temporary global rate-limiter to drop apac-destined traffic from eu origin.
eng-leo: Rolling back is fastest. Preparing rollback to p-2026-06 now.
incident-bot: Deploy pipeline: rollback request queued by eng-leo. ETA ~2m.
infra-amit: DNS note — there's also a TTL mismatch: edge metadata TTL for the policy resolver is 60s, but some proxies cache 300s. Might extend impact window beyond rollback. We're flushing resolver caches on affected proxy clusters.
oncall-jack: infra-amit, please run cache flush script on eu-west cluster A and B. Command: `./tools/flush-resolver --cluster eu-west-A --policy-resolver`
infra-amit: Running flush... ok cluster A flushed, B in progress.
cs-lina: Customer (AcmeAnalytics) reports partial recovery for new requests but backfill ingestion still errors. They're ok if we can give an ETA for full recovery.
pm-maria: Tell them we expect macro recovery within 10 minutes after rollback + cache flush, backfill retries may need to be replayed by client.
eng-leo: Rollback completed. policy now at p-2026-06 per controlplane logs.
incident-bot: Monitoring: 5xx rate dropping from 3.8% -> 1.0% in last 90s.
sre-aya: Good signal. But still seeing a small tail of errors from customers pinned to earlier DNS entries. infra-amit, any remaining caches outstanding?
infra-amit: One stale proxy pool (eu-west-C) had an iguana process that didn't pick up the cache flush. Restarting process now: `systemctl restart iguana-proxy`.
oncall-jack: After restart, confirm health checks back to normal.
infra-amit: Restart done, health checks green.
cs-lina: AcmeAnalytics confirms ingestion resumed for new writes. They're going to retry backlog. Marking as partial impact resolved.
pm-maria: I'll open a follow-up ticket to update onboarding docs around the new affinity semantics and add a safety gate to prevent default fallback to remote regions.
eng-leo: Root cause: policy change introduced an affinity fallback path that defaulted to apac region for missing session cookies. Also operator rollout happened without the safety-check that validates fallback region != remote. Secondary contributor: proxy cache TTL mismatch extended impact.
sre-aya: Action items assigned: ENG to add validation + tests (eng-leo), INFRA to standardize resolver TTLs (infra-amit), PM to update rollout checklist (pm-maria), CS to follow up with impacted customers (cs-lina).
eng-leo: I'll create a PR today with policy validation logic and add an e2e test covering cookie-less clients.
infra-amit: I'll push a config to normalize resolver TTL to 60s across proxies; scheduled change after incident to avoid churn.
pm-maria: Postmortem owner: eng-leo. Please include timeline, customer impact, and mitigation timeline. Aim to publish within 48h.
oncall-jack: Closing pager. If metrics re-breach >1% 5xx for eu-origin, I'll re-open and escalate.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident ID: INC-4309876543. Log notes appended.
cs-lina: Thanks team. I'll ping AcmeAnalytics with a summary and next steps. :thumbsup:
eng-leo: Thanks all. Will follow up with PR link in #eng-runtime.
sre-aya: Dropping postmortem checklist items into the incident board. Great coordination. :rocket:
